eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Plumas, CA; at 7:48 PM on AUG 18, 2020 Effective until 7:48 PM AUG 19, 2020. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Due to Fire Activity, the City of Loyalton, Sierra Brooks, and Loyalton Pines is under Evacuation Advisory, this is an  Advisory only. If the fire activity increases, the Evacuation Notice could be upgraded to a Voluntary, or a Mandatory Evacuation Notice. Be ready to leave at a minutes notice.
